explanation: Study selection is one module in two files: studySelectionLink.ts holds the value ({ categories, datasetIds, filters }) and its URL form (selectionFromLink / selectionLink) with registry and type imports only, so the entry-bundle router can hold it; studySelection.ts holds useStudySelection, which derives the catalog wait, selected studies, the typed { term, datasets } query, visible groups and reset, and is reached only from the lazily loaded reports because its catalog and quality imports pull in both evidence ledgers. StudySelectionPanel.tsx is the one Study filters panel both reports render. geneStudyScope.tsx and forestReport's useCategoryScope are deleted; useReportQuery takes a typed request instead of a JSON string key; searchLanding drops NOOP_SCOPE.
